content: Vitest official docs (vitest.dev/guide/environment): default env is node; jsdom and happy-dom are built-in browser envs selected via config environment or per-file control comment '// @vitest-environment happy-dom'. Docs state happy-dom is considered faster than jsdom but lacks some API. Vitest 4.1.11 is installed in this repo; neither happy-dom nor jsdom is present in node_modules. npm registry: happy-dom 20.14.3 (legitimacy verdict SUS - only 'too-new' signal from latest publish date, repo github.com/capricorn86/happy-dom, 8.9M weekly downloads); jsdom 30.0.1 (verdict OK, 53M weekly downloads).
